stages.description: Sowing/germination to panicle initiation. Direct-seeded rice has no separate nursery. Transplanted rice includes a nursery phase before transplanting; record both sowing and transplant dates and preserve the origin date of any duration. The FAO irrigation manual lists nursery separately from its post-transplant vegetative stage.
Flowering to maturity; includes grain growth
